LAREDO, Texas — Jesus Mariano Rodriguez-Ramirez was arrested Wednesday night, October 21, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on six alleged third-degree felony counts of smuggling of persons, according to Webb County booking records.

Rodriguez-Ramirez was arrested at 11:39 p.m. The booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956 listed six counts of smuggling of persons and did not name an arresting agency.

Bond had not been set on any of the counts as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Jesus Mariano Rodriguez-Ramirez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
